# Synthetic decoder fixtures

Generated locally with FFmpeg; no external media content.

```sh
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x48:rate=10 -t 0.6 -c:v libvpx -an video.webm
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x48:rate=10 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000 -t 0.6 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -movflags +faststart video-audio.mp4
```

Encoders are fixture-generation tools only. Notoir bundles decoders and does not link libx264.
PNG/GIF and PCM WAV fixtures are generated by the tests into temporary directories.
